parts.text: 不同词意导致的不同变化 We must all hang together, or assuredly we shall all hang separately. - Benjamin Franklin(一词两意)

rows: I’m hanging this picture on the wall. A painter who had been working on the tower hung a pot of paint on one of the hands and slowed it down!
The hero was hanged. As he has murdered three men, he ought to be hanged. I wonder why she hanged herself.

parts.text: I hung my coat in the hall.
Murderers will not be hanged in future.
